ct_adjoint_project — TOMOGRAPHY ct_scan op

• Datenarten: projstack × ctgeometry → voxel

• Aufruf: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ct_adjoint_project(projections, geometry, device='auto') (die Implementierung direkt: import ctscan; ctscan.ct_adjoint_project(projections, geometry, device='auto'); aus dem Register: opstomography.get("ct_adjoint_project"))

• GPU: nein (nur CPU-Referenzimplementierung)

Verwendung

Die exakte Transponierte A^T von ct_forward_project.

> Die ausführliche Beschreibung unten ist der Originaltext — Zusammenfassung und Überschriften sind übersetzt.

<A x, y> = <x, A^T y> holds to rounding, on every scan. This is what an iterative solver needs; it is not the reconstruction fdk_reconstruct does.

:param projections: (view, V, U) array. :param geometry: dict from ct_scan_geometry. :param device: "auto", "cpu" or "cuda". :returns: (Z, Y, X) float volume. :raises ValueError: on a shape that disagrees with the geometry. Empty input

(projections with 0 elements) raises ValueError.
